notes: Routing eval: for each phrase, a host that sees this skill's description among others should load it (should_fire) or not (should_not_fire). 'why' records the intended reason so a grader can tell a defensible miss from a wrong one. should_not_fire holds near-misses: phrases that share the description's vocabulary (agent, parallel, review, worktree, best of 3, background) or belong to a sibling skill.
